## Distributions

```{r}

df <- tar_read(data_prep)

```

### Missing values

```{r}

df |>
  select(-Species_2, -Sex_2, -ConfigurationName) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
  group_by(variable) |>
  summarise(
    n_missing   = sum(is.na(value)),
    pct_missing = round(100 * mean(is.na(value)), 1)
  ) |>
  filter(n_missing > 0) |>
  gt()

```

### Sex and species

```{r}
#| fig.width: 12
#| fig.height: 8

# df |>
#     select(Sex_2, Species_2) |>
#     map(tabyl)

df |>
  select(Sex_2, Species_2) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = c("Sex_2", "Species_2"),
         labels = c("Sex", "Species"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
  geom_bar() +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 16)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

### Adversity

#### Coding schemes

**Threat indicators**

| Variable        | Score          | Item description                                               |
| -------------   | -------------- | --------------                                                 |
| Life experience | 1              | Zoo (born in the former zoo and spent their life in captivity) |
|                 | 2              | Trade (rescued from poaching)                                  |
|                 | 3              | Pet (chains, cages, etc)                                       |
|                 | 3              | Entertainment (being caged in resorts, temples, etc)           |
| Physical harm   | 1              | No physical harm                                               |
|                 | 2              | Indirect (mobility restriction, chains, cage..)                |
|                 | 3              | Direct (beats, scars..)                                        |

**Deprivation indicators**

| Variable                 | Score          | Item description                                                  |
| -------------            | -------------- | --------------                                                    |
| Type of rearing          | 1              | Parenting (reared by biological parents or surogate mother/father |
|                          | 2              | Hand (reared by humans)                                           |
| Infancy social exposure  | 1              | Accompanied by peers 80% infancy                                  |
|                          | 2              | Mixed or accompanied by peers 80-20% infancy                      |
|                          | 3              | Alone more than 80% infancy                                       |
| Juvenile social exposure | 1              | Accompanied by peers 80% juvenility                               |
|                          | 2              | Mixed or accompanied by peers 80-20% juvenility                   |
|                          | 3              | Alone more than 80% juvenility                                    |
| Nutrition deprivation    | 1              | Balanced (mostly balanced during life, adequate food items)       |
|                          | 2              | Unbalanced (poor, harmful foods like soda or snacks…)             |
| Mother separation        | 1              | No                                                                |
|                          | 2              | Yes                                                               |

___NB: Mother separation is not used as an unpredictability indicator but a
       deprivation indicator contrary to what was declared in the
       preregistration.___

**Unpredictability indicators**

| Variable              | Score          | Item description                                                     |
| -------------         | -------------- | --------------                                                       |
| Number of relocations | 1              | born at the center                                                   |
|                       | 2              | relocated at least once (to the rescue center)                       |
|                       | 3              | relocated at least twice (usually market + rescue center)            |
|                       | 4              | relocated more than twice (more than two environments before center) |

#### Distributions of raw variables


```{r}
#| fig.width: 12
#| fig.height: 8

cols <- c(# Threat
          "LifeExperience", "PhysicalHarm",
          # Deprivation
          "TypeRearing", "InfancySocialExposure",
           "JuvenileSocialExposure", "MotherSeparation",
          "NutritionDep",
          # Unpredictability
          "Relocations")
labels <- c(# Threat
            "Life experience", "Physical harm",
            # Deprivation
            "Type of rearing", "Social exposure during infancy",
            "Social exposure during juvenility", "Mother separation",
            "Nutritional deprivation",
            # Unpredictability
            "Relocations")

int_breaks <- function(limits) {
  b <- seq(ceiling(limits[1]), floor(limits[2]))
  if (length(b) > 10) scales::extended_breaks()(limits) else b  # fallback for wide ranges
}

df |>
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(cols), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = cols, labels = labels)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
  geom_bar() +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = int_breaks) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 16))

```

### Psychopathology

The indicators for anxiety, depression and ISS mix behavioural observations
with items from the Macaques Social Responsiveness scale.
The latter is rated on a 1-5 Likert scale and ratings from 3 observers are
averaged. Some items are reversed scored but were already recoded in the
original source file `DataRecoded.xslx` sent by Mikel.
See [F1000research paper](https://f1000research.com/articles/13-188).

#### Anxiety

```{r}
#| fig.width: 12
#| fig.height: 8

df |>
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(ind_anxiety), names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = ind_anxiety)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
      facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 16))

```

## Distributions of continuous regression variables after imputation

```{r}
plot_imputed_density <- function(imp_list, var, alpha = 0.4) {
  # Stack the list into one long data frame with an imputation index
    long <- dplyr::bind_rows(imp_list, .id = "imputation")

  ggplot(long, aes(x = .data[[var]], group = imputation, colour = imputation)) +
    geom_density(alpha = alpha, linewidth = 0.8) +
    labs(x = var, y = "Density", colour = "Imputation") +
    theme_minimal()
}

d_imp <- tar_read(data_imp)

vars <- c("Threat", "Deprivation", "Unpredictability", "EstimatedAgeArrival",
          "YearsCenter", "Anxiety", "Depression", "ISS")

#purrr::walk(vars, \(var) print(plot_imputed_density(d_imp, var)))

plots <- purrr::map(vars, \(var) plot_imputed_density(d_imp, var)) |>
  purrr::set_names(vars)

patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2, guides = "collect")

d_imp[[1]] |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Anxiety", "Depression", "ISS"),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(variable = factor(variable)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 10) +
      facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 16))

```

sum_tab <- tar_read(summary_tab)

post_plots <- tar_read(post_plots_all)

    ~from                   , ~to        ,
    "model_vars_high_NA_1A" , "Model 1A" ,
    "model_vars_high_NA_1C" , "Model 1B" ,
    "model_vars_high_NA_2A" , "Model 2A" ,

### Summary table for all models (PREDICTORS ONLY)

```{r}

sum_tab |>
    filter(!grepl("^(sd_|sigma|rescor)", parameter),
           !grepl("Sex_2|Species_2", parameter),
           grepl("model_vars_.*(A|C)$", model)) |>
    mutate(model = model |> recode_values(from = lookup_models$from,
                                          to = lookup_models$to),
           parameter = parameter |> recode_values(
               from = lookup_parameters$from,
               to = lookup_parameters$to)
           ) |>
    gt_summary_table()

```

### Summary table for all models (ALL PARAMETERS)

```{r}

sum_tab |>
    filter(grepl("model_vars_.*(A|C)$", model)) |>
    mutate(model = model |> recode_values(from = lookup_models$from,
                                          to = lookup_models$to)) |>
    gt_summary_table()

```

### Model 1A - Dimensional analysis between early-life adversity predictors and behavioural outcomes

```{r}

pf1A <- tar_read(pfit_model_vars_high_NA_1A)
f1A <- tar_read(fit_model_vars_high_NA_1A)


sum_tab |>
    filter(grepl("model_vars_.*1A$", model)) |>
    mutate(model = model |> recode_values(from = lookup_models$from,
                                          to = lookup_models$to)) |>
    gt_summary_table()

```

```{r}
#| fig.width: 10
#| fig.height: 14

plot_prior_posterior(f1A, pf1A, responses = c("Anxiety", "Depression", "ISS"),
                     exclude = "Intercept|Sex_2|Species_2",
                     response_colours = c(Anxiety = "#1b9e77",
                                          Depression = "#d95f02",

                     title = "Model 1A - Dimensional analysis between early-life adversity predictors\nand behavioural outcomes"
)

```

### Model comparisons

#### Dimensional approach vs cumulative approach

```{r}

comp <- tar_read(model_comp1A_1C)
comp$diffs |> as_tibble() |>
    mutate(model = c("Dimensional model 1A", "Cumulative model 1B"), .before = 1 ) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
    gt(rowname_col = "model")

```

```{r}

comp <- tar_read(model_comp2A_2C)
comp$diffs |> as_tibble() |>
    mutate(model = c("Dimensional model 2A", "Cumulative model 2B"), .before = 1 ) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
    gt(rowname_col = "model")

```

```{r}

comp <- tar_read(model_comp3A_3C)
comp$diffs |> as_tibble() |>
    mutate(model = c("Dimensional model 3A", "Cumulative model 3B"), .before = 1 ) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
    gt(rowname_col = "model")

```

#### Model without moderators vs model with moderators

**Estimated age at the center**

```{r}

comp <- tar_read(model_comp1A_2A)
comp$diffs |> as_tibble() |>
    mutate(model = c("Dimensional model without moderators", "Dimensional model with EstimatedAgeArrival as moderator"), .before = 1 ) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
    gt(rowname_col = "model")

```

**Years spent at the center**

```{r}

comp <- tar_read(model_comp1A_3A)
comp$diffs |> as_tibble() |>
    mutate(model = c("Dimensional model without moderators", "Dimensional model with YearsCenter as moderator"), .before = 1 ) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
    gt(rowname_col = "model")

```
